accepted_scope.branch_creation: Coordinator may create the exact already authorized engineering evidence branch from an explicitly verified repository commit; this library has no branch creation endpoint.
accepted_scope.use: Auxiliary synthetic engineering records and actual verification observations only. A signature-verification observation may be preserved here as evidence while owner_merge_commit continues to refer to the actual main merge that signed the payload.
accepted_scope.formal_run: Always BLOCKED; zero side effects, irrespective of caller acceptance booleans

source_boundary.interpretation: The fixed private engineering branch is permitted for auxiliary immutable evidence. It is not a live RootSet, GA, GRR or Control Canonical Store and does not replace current authority or revocation reads. No new signing or production purpose follows.
source_boundary.normal_code_and_acceptance_process: Main PR and required checks remain unchanged.
source_boundary.ci_observation: Existing worktree push triggers cover main and named historical phase2/feat branches, not this new exact evidence branch. No workflow changed and no live CI/cost status is asserted.

reviewed_controls: Exact fixed repository full_name and private is True checked before publication and every Git mutation.
Exact existing branch/ref/commit head required; branch absence cannot create it.
Complete non-truncated parent tree; target must be absent; only one new ordinary 100644 blob path; new complete leaf set must equal old plus this path.
Blob, tree and single-parent commit created with fixed endpoint and message; fixed ref update uses force:false; exact pre/post head checks.
No overwrite or force update. A concurrent divergent branch advance fails; unknown outcome retains evidence and cannot dispatch actions. This is not atomic fencing of later external work.
CreateNew fsynced local ticket and per-object progress; original bytes bound by size/SHA256/Git blob, exact immutable commit/tree/blob GET readback.
Per-attempt transport object identities reset before local ticket creation; no previous attempt SHA misattribution after early failure.
Result binds original same-attempt Intent reference and exact bytes; top-level authorization/execution/currentness/qualification flags remain false. Auxiliary framing is not GRR.

resolved_findings.problem: Fixed repository name alone did not ensure private visibility at write time.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict full_name/private guard before all mutations; public/missing/non-boolean private denies.

resolved_findings.problem: Previous attempt immutable object references could leak into a later UNKNOWN before create_file reset.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reset publication_objects at new attempt start; old local tickets retained and no automatic retry.

targeted_execution.command: Host Python -I -S -B -X utf8, independent in-memory assertions with subprocess/network and persistence mocked closed.
checks: Ticket persistence failure returns UNKNOWN with no stale object SHA and makes zero API calls.
Each of blob/tree/commit/ref stages rejects a public repository before any subprocess.
formal_run with forged qualified/accepted booleans still dispatches zero actions.

actual_use_conditions: Bind the exact accepted source and trusted host CLI, current Owner window and fixed branch starting commit; verify all input bytes are authorized synthetic/control-engineering data without secrets or user payload.
Use publish_once, never bypass tickets or directly call private mutation helpers as a retry/alternative path. Serialize with other operations on this exact evidence branch.
When outcome is UNKNOWN, preserve known object identities and tickets; recover via exact immutable readback, not blind republish or resetting capacity.
Consumers must independently verify actual signatures/payload/source references; a stored verification report boolean is evidence, not authority.

A real engineering publication/readback observation may proceed under the existing scope. It does not prove formal S06 sink durability or qualify the controller; formal Root/Profile/GA/revocation/budget/STOP/action prerequisites remain separate.
